messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Quality regression detected for tenant AcmeCorp (tenant_id: acme-123) on dedicated-pool us-west-2. Metric: generation_quality_score dropped 18% vs baseline. Auto-abort not triggered.
Maya SRE: Paging oncall. I'm taking it. I'll triage impact and cut a mitigation plan. @Rachel AM can you confirm if AcmeCorp is currently on a support call?
Rachel AM: Not on a call. Just emailed them; they reported token-level hallucinations in production at ~09:12 PDT. They're high priority (Enterprise contract).
Maya SRE: Thanks. Quick context: we rolled a new quantization profile (q8_2alpha) to acme-usw2 pool ~02:00 UTC last night to reduce cost. Rollout targeted dedicated pool, only tenant acme-123. Early evals looked fine.
Sam ML: Reproduced locally with the q8_2alpha profile on gptx-7b: outputs shorter responses and increased false-positives on entity extraction prompts. Looks like reduced precision in some layers.
Erin Platform: Confirming routing: all acme traffic is pinned to dedicated pool acme-usw2 and model gptx-7b-q. No fallback configured for tenant because of latency SLA.
Maya SRE: Customer impact: degraded output quality causing incorrect product descriptions, intermittent failures for their search rerank pipeline. Priority = P1 (customer-facing, revenue impact).
Maya SRE: Immediate mitigation options: 1) revert quant profile on pool 2) pin tenant to FP16 variant of model 3) route traffic to host fallback cluster (higher cost) 4) rate-limit experimental routes.
Josh Oncall: I can take the rollback if we agree. What's safest? Rolling back profile seems lowest-risk.
Sam ML: Agree: revert quant profile for that pool to previous profile q16_baseline. We should also pin model to gptx-7b-fp16 for a short window and run smoke tests.
Maya SRE: Plan:
- Step A (now): set pool profile back to q16_baseline for acme-usw2
- Step B (in parallel): update routing to serve acme -> gptx-7b-fp16 for 10m canary
- Step C: run smoke evals (prompt set) and confirm quality
- Step D: if good, keep fp16 for 24h and schedule postmortem
- Step E: longer-term: iterate quant profile with regression tests
Maya SRE: Rolling Step A now.
Maya SRE: ```
# revert quant profile for dedicated pool
rdctl pools update --pool acme-usw2 --quant-profile q16_baseline --tenant acme-123
``` 
ops-bot: Command accepted. Started job job-7742. Estimated completion ~60s.
ops-bot: Job job-7742 completed successfully. New profile q16_baseline applied to pool acme-usw2.
Maya SRE: Starting Step B canary: pin tenant routing to gptx-7b-fp16 for 10% of traffic for 5m to validate.
Erin Platform: ```
# route 10% to fp16 canary
rdctl route update --tenant acme-123 --model gptx-7b-fp16 --traffic 10
``` 
ops-bot: Canary rule created (canary-305). Monitoring logs and QA evals for 5m.
Sam ML: Running smoke evals now against the canonical prompt set.
Sam ML: Smoke evals show quality metric back to baseline on canary samples. Running larger sample.
Lee CS: I told Acme support that we're testing a fix, asked them to hold traffic if they can. They appreciate quick action.
Sam ML: Larger eval (200 prompts) shows mean quality drop reduced from -18% to -1.5%. Looks good.
Maya SRE: Based on canary, promote fp16 routing for all acme traffic and keep q16 profile on pool.
Maya SRE: ```
# promote to 100%
rdctl route update --tenant acme-123 --model gptx-7b-fp16 --traffic 100
``` 
ops-bot: Route update accepted. All traffic for acme-123 now served by gptx-7b-fp16.
Maya SRE: Monitoring customer logs and metrics. Please watch for any latency regressions (expect ~8-12% increase CPU/GPU usage).
Erin Platform: Noted. We're seeing latency +10% and cost delta. Documenting change in incident ticket.
Rachel AM: Notified customer that we've reverted the optimization and traffic now on fp16. They asked for a follow-up postmortem.
Maya SRE: Handoff: I'm going offline in 30m, handing to @Josh Oncall for monitoring and next steps. Josh, take over incident channel.
Josh Oncall: Taking over. I'll keep watch for 2 hours and coordinate postmortem with Sam and Erin.
Maya SRE: Postmortem owner: Sam ML. Remediation actions: 1) Add quant-profile regression tests to eval harness 2) Add canary gating for tenant-scoped profile changes 3) Update runbook for tenant rollback steps
Sam ML: Acknowledged. Will create follow-up PRs and link to incident.
Maya SRE: Incident classified = customer-impacting (Enterprise) - mitigated. Closing active mitigation phase, leaving incident open for postmortem and docs.
incident-bot: Incident ticket INC-2026-0142 created. Severity: Customer P1. Assignees: Sam ML, Erin Platform, Maya SRE. ETA postmortem draft 72h.
Josh Oncall: Logged timeline and actions to the ticket. I'll add final logs and close monitoring window at 2h mark.
Rachel AM: Scheduling a customer readout tomorrow 09:00 PDT. Sending calendar invite.
Maya SRE: Thanks everyone. Great quick ops. :thumbsup:
